raw.query: WITH infill AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN op_name='encoder_attention' THEN batch_size WHEN op_name='gemm' AND (n,k) IN ((4096,4608),(4608,4608)) THEN (m/196)::int WHEN op_name='gemm' THEN (m/784)::int END AS batch_n, CASE WHEN op_name='encoder_attention' THEN isl=784 WHEN op_name='gemm' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_448_shape FROM provenance.collector_kernel_perf WHERE source_path ILIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/%'), per_n AS (SELECT op_name,batch_n,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_448_shape) AS cases_448,COUNT(DISTINCT ROW(batch_size,isl,num_heads,head_dim,attn_dtype,gemm_dtype,m,n,k)) FILTER (WHERE is_448_shape) AS shapes_448 FROM infill GROUP BY op_name,batch_n), expected AS (SELECT op_name,batch_n,expected_shapes FROM (VALUES ('encoder_attention',1),('gemm',6)) f(op_name,expected_shapes) CROSS JOIN generate_series(1,64) batch_n), coverage AS (SELECT e.op_name,COUNT(*) AS denominator_n,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(p.shapes_448,0)=e.expected_shapes) AS exact_n,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(p.shapes_448,0)<>e.expected_shapes) AS nonexact_n,SUM(COALESCE(p.cases_448,0)) AS cases_448,MIN(COALESCE(p.shapes_448,0)) AS min_shapes_per_n,MAX(COALESCE(p.shapes_448,0)) AS max_shapes_per_n,jsonb_object_agg(e.batch_n,COALESCE(p.shapes_448,0) ORDER BY e.batch_n) AS per_n_shapes FROM expected e LEFT JOIN per_n p USING(op_name,batch_n) GROUP BY e.op_name), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cases,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE op_name='encoder_attention') AS attention_cases,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE op_name='gemm') AS gemm_cases,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_448_shape) AS cases_448,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_448_shape) AS extra_non448_cases,COUNT(DISTINCT source_path) AS source_files FROM infill), manifest AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS files,SUM(n_rows) AS manifest_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT sha256) AS distinct_hashes FROM provenance.ingest_log WHERE file_path ILIKE '%/phaseC_vit_shape_infill/%'), ledger AS (SELECT id,command,artifact_paths,supersedes FROM provenance.ledger_entry WHERE id=974), status AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_dim_matches,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_current OR superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS noncurrent_dim_matches FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE source_path ILIKE '%phaseC_vit_shape_infill%' OR run_id ILIKE '%infill%' OR experiment ILIKE '%infill%'), later_supersession AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS entries FROM provenance.ledger_entry WHERE id<>974 AND (supersedes ILIKE '%Phase C shape infill%' OR supersedes ILIKE '%id=974%' OR supersedes ILIKE '%interpolated 448 px query path%')) SELECT t.*,m.files AS manifest_files,m.manifest_rows,m.distinct_hashes,s.current_dim_matches,s.noncurrent_dim_matches,l.id AS ledger_id,l.command AS ledger_command,l.artifact_paths AS ledger_artifacts,l.supersedes AS ledger_supersedes,ls.entries AS later_superseding_entries,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('op',c.op_name,'denominator_n',c.denominator_n,'exact_n',c.exact_n,'nonexact_n',c.nonexact_n,'cases_448',c.cases_448,'min_shapes_per_n',c.min_shapes_per_n,'max_shapes_per_n',c.max_shapes_per_n,'per_n_shapes',c.per_n_shapes) ORDER BY c.op_name) AS coverage FROM totals t CROSS JOIN manifest m CROSS JOIN status s CROSS JOIN ledger l CROSS JOIN later_supersession ls CROSS JOIN coverage c GROUP BY t.total_cases,t.attention_cases,t.gemm_cases,t.cases_448,t.extra_non448_cases,t.source_files,m.files,m.manifest_rows,m.distinct_hashes,s.current_dim_matches,s.noncurrent_dim_matches,l.id,l.command,l.artifact_paths,l.supersedes,ls.entries
